posts.title: Editing multiple occurrances in Xcode (with Vim)
posts.description: Here is a real gem of a tip burried deep within the Swift 6 migration video to edit multiple occurances of a word/keyword in one fell swoop. Select the text If you are sitting at the first character in the word, use ve to select to the end of the word. If you are in the middle of the word, viw will select the entire thing. Press Cmd+Opt+e to select the next occurance.
